# Interest Rate and Risk Management Optimization

This document outlines key initiatives for the Credit & Loans department.

*   Optimize the standard update process for interest rates.
*   Urgently optimize interest rates.
*   Update interest rates based on audit findings.
*   Investigate the standard update process for default risk.
*   Monitor collateral value on a quarterly basis.
